adjudication.evidence: P1 (460–475) shows a sustained N/U drop and partial E rise, but no opposing return; residual plots show persistent offset after 475, indicating permanent step, not temporary platform. P2 (501–503) is a 2-day spike in all components with no sustained plateau or return—residuals confirm it’s an isolated jump, not a platform. P3 (505) is a single-point outlier (U ~ -5.6 mm), inconsistent with temporary offset definition requiring sustained shift+return. No candidate satisfies the criterion of sustained shift followed by opposing return across same axes. Physical motion (e.g., E trend) continues uninterrupted through all intervals.
